title: Training Note: Energy Assistance Pledge Points on a Reinstated Security Deposits Installment
content:
Pledge points are earned toward the first installment of a Security Deposits deposit reinstated on the waiver reinstatement basis while its service account waits to be reconnected. They come from the energy assistance pledges recorded on the Electric Service by Rate Schedule account the reinstated deposit secures.

## The rule

A pledge recorded less than one whole month before today earns the recent-pledge points of **5**. Where no pledge is that recent but one was recorded less than three whole months before today, the account earns the older-pledge points of **3**. An account with no pledge recorded in the last three months earns no pledge points. Pledge points count as relief points, which are taken off the first-installment share in percentage points, never off the amount.

## Questions answered

**Which records count?** The energy assistance pledges recorded on the service account itself, dated by the date the pledge was recorded.

**The account has one pledge recorded two weeks ago and another recorded ten weeks ago. How many points?**
5. The recent pledge earns the recent-pledge points; the points do not add up across pledges.

**The only pledge was recorded two whole months and some days ago.**
3, since it is less than three whole months old and no pledge is less than one whole month old.

**The only pledge was recorded four months ago.**
None; no pledge was recorded in the last three months.

## Summary

| Most recent pledge recorded on the account | Pledge points |
|---|---|
| less than one whole month before today | 5 |
| one whole month or more, but less than three whole months, before today | 3 |
| none in the last three months | none |
